about.title: Three Decades of Uncompromising Marine Craftsmanship
about.description: Rooted in the renowned shipbuilding traditions of Pula and operating directly from the historic Avangard Shipyard, Heritage Decks is spearheaded by master marine carpenter Perica Bajs. For over 30 years, our workshop has engineered bespoke teak decks, combining hand-selected timber, precision jointing, and vacuum bonding to meet the exacting standards of international luxury yachts and heritage vessels.

services.title: Specialized Marine Woodworking & Deck Solutions
services.subtitle: Comprehensive deck engineering and refit services for motor yachts, sailing vessels, and superyachts.

decking.title: Custom Teak Decking
decking.description: Bespoke traditional Burmese teak and sustainable engineered composite marine decking, custom-fitted with premium caulking systems.

scanning.title: 3D Laser Scanning & CAD Modeling
scanning.description: Sub-millimeter 3D digitizing of yacht deck geometries, eliminating manual measuring errors and ensuring absolute prefabrication accuracy.

refit.title: Deck Refit & Restoration
refit.description: Complete removal of aged decks, subdeck leveling, recaulking, precision sanding, and structural renovation to factory-new standards.

carpentry.title: Bespoke Marine Carpentry
carpentry.description: Handcrafted cap rails, grating, teak cockpit tables, swim platforms, margin boards, and custom architectural woodwork.

maintenance.title: Preventive Care & Sealing
maintenance.description: Eco-friendly nano-coating protection, deep biological cleaning, mold removal, and seasonal yacht preservation treatments.

survey.title: Condition Assessment & Consulting
survey.description: Technical inspections of existing deck substrates, moisture testing, seam integrity analysis, and detailed restoration roadmaps.

process.title: Our Precision Engineering & Crafting Workflow
process.subtitle: A disciplined 4-stage digital refit methodology delivering millimeter perfection from initial scan to final handover.

step1.title: 3D Scan & Digital Twin
step1.description: High-precision on-site laser scanning creates an exact digital replica of the vessel's deck layout and curvature.

step2.title: Workshop Prefabrication
step2.description: CNC milling, hand selection of uniform quarter-sawn grain, and vacuum-bonded panel construction in climate-controlled conditions.

step3.title: On-Site Vacuum Bonding
step3.description: Fast and clean on-vessel installation using advanced marine structural adhesives and continuous vacuum clamping without screws.

step4.title: Finishing & Handover
step4.description: Multi-stage orbital sanding, seam caulking inspection, application of breathable marine sealants, and client sign-off.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our teak decks, maintenance, and project lifecycles.
faq.q1: What is 3D deck laser scanning and why is it superior?
faq.a1: 3D laser scanning captures millions of coordinates across your yacht's deck in minutes, achieving sub-millimeter precision. It eliminates inaccuracies of manual cardboard templating, allows 90% of deck assembly in our workshop, and drastically reduces the boat's downtime in the marina.
faq.q2: What timber species do you work with?
faq.a2: We specialize in genuine Burmese Golden Teak (Tectona grandis) sourced with strict sustainability documentation. We also craft high-performance synthetic composite decks and plantation-grown alternative hardwoods depending on your project specifications.
faq.q3: How long does a typical teak deck refit take?
faq.a3: Thanks to workshop prefabrication, actual on-board installation is reduced to 7-14 days for mid-size motor yachts and sailing boats. Total project time from digital survey to handover typically spans 3 to 5 weeks.
faq.q4: Are screws used to secure the new deck?
faq.a4: Never. We use modern vacuum-assisted adhesive bonding. By avoiding screws through the deck core, your subdeck remains 100% watertight, preventing any potential fiberglass delamination or core rot.
faq.q5: Where is your primary facility and what territory do you cover?
faq.a5: Our main workshop and prefabrication base is situated within the historic Avangard Shipyard in Pula, Istria. In addition, our mobile team directly serves all ports across Croatia, Italy (Venice, Trieste, Monfalcone, Ancona), and Slovenia.

accessibility.title: WCAG 2.2 AA / AAA Compliance Statement
accessibility.intro: Heritage Decks is committed to ensuring digital accessibility for people of all abilities. We continually improve the user experience for everyone and apply relevant accessibility standards.
accessibility.measuresDesc: We implement high-contrast focus rings (SC 2.4.13), unobstructed focus viewport padding (SC 2.4.11 & 2.4.12), touch target sizes of 48px compliant with WCAG 2.5.8, reduced-motion adaptation (SC 2.3.3), input purpose identification (SC 1.3.5), keyboard navigation traps for modals, and full screen reader compatibility with ARIA standards.
accessibility.statusDesc: The Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) defines requirements for designers and developers to improve accessibility for people with disabilities. Heritage Decks is fully conformant with WCAG 2.2 Level AA and satisfies key Level AAA criteria.
accessibility.feedbackDesc: We welcome your feedback on the accessibility of Heritage Decks. Please let us know if you encounter accessibility barriers.
